experiment: SYS-236 experiment004 technical-domain fixed-policy stress test
scope: local evaluation only; no input, telemetry, installation, training or threshold selection

selection.candidates: EN blob paths matching ^src/ch[0-9]{2}[^/]*[.]md$; RU ^rustbook-ru/src/ch[0-9]{2}[^/]*[.]md$; exclude no content based on detector outcomes

segmentation.fenced_code: line with at most3 leading ASCII spaces followed by >=3 backticks or tildes opens fence; same marker and >= opening length closes; all interior lines protected; opening/closing lines excluded
segmentation.inline_code: outside fences, runs of backticks paired with next equal-length run on same line; contents protected; unmatched run treated as prose
segmentation.other_markdown: retained literally; no link/HTML/include execution or fetching; no Markdown renderer
segmentation.tokens: split spans on Unicode whitespace; strip only .!?;:,()[]{}"«»“”„ from both ends; retain other punctuation and case; exclude empty; fail if token exceeds4096 UTF16 or total rows500000
segmentation.typed_layout: oracle: if token contains any Cyrillic RU letter then ru; otherwise us (ASCII Latin terms in Russian prose remain us); mixed unsupported not silently translated
segmentation.wrong_copies: only prose tokens entirely ASCII EN letters or RU33 letters, length1..32; convert to opposite layout preserving case; no artificial corruption of protected code
segmentation.labels: valid and protected always intent Keep even when dictionaries disagree; wrong eligible recovery only if NOT (stemBoth OR controlBoth OR fullBoth); ambiguous wrong changes unsafe; roundtrip must equal original

model.thresholds: exact frozen values from data/experiment-002-protocol.json; never refit

protected_policy: protected variants force Keep on labelled code; prose actions identical to their base. This is oracle markup context, not a validated keyboard-input context detector.

metrics.primary: eligible valid/protected (supported >=4) false changes per language and pooled; all valid false changes also reported; wrong unambiguous eligible recovery; ambiguous wrong unsafe separately
metrics.types: unique(document language, role, typed layout, exact text); document counts/rates and macro summaries; no IID confidence claims
metrics.budget: research screen only: <=1 false change per10000 eligible valid prose occurrences AND <=1 per10000 eligible valid prose exact types, per language AND pooled; zero protected code changes; >=50% eligible unambiguous wrong recovery per language AND pooled; insufficient if any denominator zero
metrics.no_selection: evaluate every preregistered policy; do not select thresholds or exceptions from this test; passing screen is not production approval
metrics.overlap: measure exact source hash duplication across language and old Tatoeba valid exact token overlap; translated books share topics; not independent RU/EN sources

hypotheses.D1: confirmedMorph fewer unsafe natural actions than full with reported lost recoveries, occurrences and types; equal errors => inconclusive
hypotheses.D2: model fallback adds eligible recoveries beyond full; added false/ambiguous/code changes mandatory; no free-safety inference
hypotheses.D3: oracle code protection prevents >0 raw protected changes while prose actions identical; if no changes initially then benefit inconclusive
hypotheses.D4: apply frozen budget to all methods, publish every pass/fail/insufficient by language; no production precision inferred

publication: only source passports/notices/code/aggregate counts, hashes; no corpus, token text, per-case actions, user data or model weights
